clinical_note: Patient presents with severe shortness of breath, chronic cough, and fatigue. History of heavy smoking. Preliminary assessment indicates chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) with acute lower respiratory infection.
Patient reports persistent polyuria, polydipsia, and unexplained weight loss over the past 3 months. Fasting blood glucose level is 210 mg/dL. Diagnosis consistent with Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus.
Patient complains of severe throbbing headache localized on the left side, accompanied by nausea and photophobia. Symptoms consistent with acute migraine without aura.
